items.title: 68089_John Malachi oral history interview
items.q: whenever Oscar Peterson or Ahmad Jamal play, it's in their contract to have a decent piano

ctx.x: Anyway, I think the pathetic thing about it was that Art

played a spinet piano. He was doing the solo then. It was tuned and everything, and I guess at that time it was fairly new. But it was still a spinet, and I think it was probably a Wurlitzer or something like that. It wasn't any kind of a good instrument that you would imagine somebody like Art Tatum playing at all. When you think about it now, when there were... For example, whenever Oscar Peterson or Ahmad Jamal play, it's in their contract to have a decent piano, and most times it's a 9-foot Steinway grand or,…

But Art Tatum went through a lot of things like that, playing all sorts of lousy pianos and everything. And he never seemed to complain at all. A lot of times you didn't know how lousy the piano was until you sat down and tried to play it yourself! Then you realized that it was just something different about the way he did it, that you didn't notice these things when he was playing.
